response.text: This is not SQLite; it appears to be PostgreSQL. I'll use information_schema instead.

arguments.sql: SELECT table_schema, table_name, table_type FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema NOT IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema') ORDER BY table_schema, table_name;

SELECT table_schema, table_name, column_name, data_type, is_nullable, character_maximum_length, numeric_precision, numeric_scale FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema NOT IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema') ORDER BY table_schema, table_name, ordinal_position;
